supportingSources.label: Laser War Ion Cannon rules cross-check

strategy.summary: Build W-A-R and one color bank, start Two-Ball Multiball at its base, relock both balls in different bases, then hit all nine color targets before collecting Ion Cannon at the ramp.

quickInfo.name: W-A-R
quickInfo.summary: Complete the top lanes to advance Bonus X and add value to the three color bonuses.

quickInfo.name: Two-Ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete a color bank, lock at its lit base, and plunge the replacement ball to start it.

quickInfo.name: Three-Ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: During two-ball play, lock both balls in different bases and plunge the served ball to start it.

quickInfo.name: Ion Cannon Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: Each of the nine color targets adds 100,000 before the ramp collects the built value.

quickInfo.name: Ramp Multiplier
quickInfo.summary: Repeat the ramp while its lamp remains lit to raise the ramp's own value through 5x.

steps.text: Plunge through an unlit W, A, or R lane. Use the right flipper to move the lit letters before the ball commits.
Complete W-A-R to advance Bonus X toward 5x.
modeNotes: W-A-R: W adds 2,000 to red, A adds 2,000 to yellow, and R adds 2,000 to blue.

steps.text: Watch one full pop-bumper exit. Choose the color bank with the safest standup returns.
Complete all three targets in one color. Shoot that color's lit base and plunge the served ball.
modeNotes: Two-Ball Multiball: The base holds the first ball; the replacement plunge releases it and starts two-ball play.

steps.text: Lock the first ball in any base. Send the second ball to a different base before the first ball ejects.
modeNotes: Two-base relock: Both balls must be held in different bases to qualify the next phase.

steps.text: After both balls are held, plunge the served ball to release them and start Three-Ball Multiball.
modeNotes: Three-Ball Multiball: The objective stays active until one ball remains.

steps.text: Hit all nine red, yellow, and blue targets before you shoot the ramp.
modeNotes: Ion Cannon Jackpot: Each color target adds 100,000, so all nine targets build the collect to 1,000,000.

steps.text: Shoot the ramp to collect Ion Cannon. After one ball remains, resume Bonus X and color-bonus play.

fallback.title: Recovery: Bonus and one safe base
fallback.when: Recovery pivot: Use this when the two-base relock is unreliable.

steps.text: Spell W-A-R with right-flipper lane change.
Build one color bonus with its targets, top lane, and base.
Complete that color bank and start Two-Ball Multiball.
Use two-ball protection to test the other base returns.
Do not force the second relock if one base feed is dangerous.
Protect the end-of-ball bonus.

alternatives.title: Position play: Ramp multiplier loop
alternatives.when: When trailing, use this higher-ceiling route: use this when the ramp is repeatable in single-ball play.

steps.text: Shoot the ramp once and confirm that the Ramp Multiplier lamp is lit.
Repeat the ramp while the Ramp Multiplier lamp remains lit to add 1x.
Continue to the 5x ramp-value maximum while the lamp and feed remain safe.
When multiball starts, change to the Ion Cannon target-and-ramp route.

alternatives.title: Base-number awards
alternatives.when: Use this when all three base lanes return safely.

steps.text: Shoot all three bases with number 1 flashing, then collect 100,000 at the ramp.
Shoot all three bases with number 2 flashing, then collect Hold Bonuses at the ramp.
The number 3 set lights Extra Ball; its tournament value depends on settings.
Start Three-Ball Multiball.
Hit all nine color targets before the ramp.
Collect the 1,000,000 Ion Cannon Jackpot.
Hit each color's three targets, matching W-A-R top lane, and base until all three color bonuses reach 31,000. Complete W-A-R until Bonus X reaches 5x.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm Data East Laser War ROM 8.3 and read ball-count, Bonus X, Bonus Hold, Extra Ball, Special, and tournament settings.
Verify all nine color targets, three bases, W-A-R lane change, ramp multiplier lamp, Ion Cannon, and numbered base awards.
Test each base eject, ramp entrance and wireform return, pop exits, target rebounds, tilt sensitivity, and flipper strength.

techniques.name: Two-base relock
techniques.instruction: Trap one ball when possible, lock the other, then use the controlled ball for a different base.

techniques.name: Immediate ramp loop
techniques.instruction: The ramp returns to the right flipper. Repeat it while the Ramp Multiplier remains lit.

strategy.simpleOverview: Completing one red, green, or blue target bank in Laser War lights that color's base for two-ball play. Relock the two active balls in different bases to start three-ball Multiball. Complete W-A-R to raise Bonus X, then hit all nine color targets before shooting the ramp for Ion Cannon.
strategy.overview: Completing one red, green, or blue target bank in Laser War lights that color's base for two-ball play. Complete one color and start two-ball play, store both balls in different bases, then release them for three-ball Multiball. Hit all nine color targets before the ramp to build the full Ion Cannon collect.
machineSetup: Confirm Data East Laser War ROM 8.3 and read ball-count, Bonus X, Bonus Hold, Extra Ball, Special, and tournament settings.
Verify all nine color targets, three bases, W-A-R lane change, ramp multiplier lamp, Ion Cannon, and numbered base awards.
Test each base eject, ramp entrance and wireform return, pop exits, target rebounds, tilt sensitivity, and flipper strength.
